Refund tax should use `decimal.ROUND_DOWN`.

Invoice tax stays on `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, the March 2026 decision. Since Finance said refund tax rounds "separately from invoice tax", the two shouldn't share one rounding path.

The code doesn't set a rounding mode anywhere yet. A search for `ROUND_` and `quantize` found no matches in the source, so there is nothing to change there yet.

I updated the stored tax-rounding memory so it applies to invoice tax only. I also added a new memory recording `ROUND_DOWN` for refund tax, dated 2026-10-02.
